item.title: Maryland football hires Clint Trickett as offensive coordinator

item.title: American-Islamic civil rights group urges UMD to dismiss charges against detained student journalists
item.description: UMPD detained the student journalists in October as they covered an event hosted by this university’s Student Supporting Israel chapter.

item.title: UMD republishes list of 25 key demands from Black student leaders under firewall
item.description: The list is once again accessible on the website of the university’s belonging and community office, but no longer tracks the progress made on each issue.

item.title: Lauren Karn looked to the transfer portal for answers. Has Maryland softball found them?
item.description: The Terps brought in 12 new faces this offseason, targeting players who increased the team's athleticism with a variety of skillsets.

item.title: UMD SGA calls for accountability after UMBC alum disappeared in Philippines
item.description: Anicoche, a UMBC alum, was conducting humanitarian work when the Armed Forces of the Philippines conducted bombings in Abra de Ilog, Occidental Mindoro on Jan. 1.

item.title: ICE cannot re-detain Kilmar Armando Ábrego García, federal judge rules
item.description: Ábrego García made national headlines after he was wrongly deported to him home country of El Salvador in March.

item.title: UMD, USM union members rally in Annapolis for better pay, binding arbitration
item.description: Binding arbitration refers to bringing in the neutral third-party — or arbitrator — to oversee negotiations between union members and their employers.

item.title: Maryland women’s lacrosse storms back in fourth quarter to beat Georgetown, 10-7
item.description: Kristen Shanahan was the Terps’ main distributor with six assists in their win against Virginia, but she took on the scoring load Wednesday.

item.title: Andre Mills drops career-high 39 points in Maryland men’s basketball’s 78-74 loss to Northwestern
item.description: The Texas A&M transfer has logged double-digit points in five of Maryland’s six games this month.

item.title: How extra rest propelled Carter Young to new success for Maryland wrestling
item.description: A midseason transfer left Young with a lack of recent training when he arrived at Maryland. But he's been nearly perfect for the Terps.
